prompt:
Theme: Outlines Drawn in Black

Subject: A vertical 2:3 fashion portrait. A woman leans against a concrete wall slightly to the right of the center, her body occupying about 70% of the frame. On the left, a long corridor leading deep into the background creates ample negative space, highlighting the architectural lines from floor to ceiling.

Person & Expression: Fine, bright skin with natural whiteness and subtle rosiness. Avoid excessive whitening; leave soft highlights and natural texture on the cheeks, collarbone, arms, and legs. Long dark brown wavy hair flows to the waist, with bangs naturally framing the face. An adult, composed expression, with the chin slightly raised and the face turned slightly left. The gaze is just off-camera. Rose-beige lips, delicate eyeliner, and natural makeup.

Outfit & Pose: A deep V-neck black tight mini dress. Short cap sleeves, an elegant wrap bodice, small cut-outs at the waist, and a thin drawstring with subtle gathers at the right hip. Matte stretch fabric that highlights a mature model's long legs and curves. Leaning her back and right shoulder against the wall, hips shifted slightly right. The left leg is extended forward, weight on the right leg. Holding a black half-moon leather handbag by the straps. Black pointed slingback heels and delicate gold jewelry.

Background & Light: A modern architectural corridor of exposed concrete. Floor and ceiling are gray. No furniture or text. Strong natural light from the top right illuminates the face and right side of the body. Long shadows fall toward the bottom left, with the corridor's depth sinking into darkness. High contrast between cold gray, deep black, and warm skin tones.

Composition & Camera: Low-angle shot from the waist. Full body including feet. 50mm equivalent focal length, vertical orientation. Focus on the face and outfit with a soft background blur.

Texture & Style: Photorealistic, reminiscent of a high-end Japanese fashion magazine. Skin appears transparent yet natural with visible pores. Sharp resolution without being overly processed.

promptZh:
主题：黑色勾勒的轮廓

主体：2:3 纵向时尚人像。一位女性略微偏向画面中心右侧，倚靠在 混凝土墙 上，其身体占据了约 70% 的画面。左侧是一条通向背景深处的长廊，营造出充足的留白，突显了从地面到天花板的建筑线条。

人物与表情：细腻、明亮的皮肤，带有自然的白皙感和淡淡的红润。避免过度美白；在脸颊、锁骨、手臂和腿部保留柔和的高光和自然纹理。长款 深棕色 波浪卷发垂至腰间，刘海自然地修饰脸型。成熟、沉稳的表情，下巴微抬，脸部略微转向左侧。视线看向镜头外。玫瑰米色嘴唇，精致的眼线，妆容自然。

服装与姿势：深 V 领 黑色 修身迷你裙。短盖袖，优雅的裹身胸衣，腰部有小镂空设计，右臀部有细抽绳和微妙的褶皱。哑光弹力面料，突显成熟模特的修长双腿和曲线。背部和右肩倚靠在墙上，臀部略微向右偏移。左腿向前伸展，重心落在右腿上。手提黑色半月形皮包。黑色尖头露跟高跟鞋，佩戴精致的金色首饰。

背景与光影：清水混凝土构成的现代建筑长廊。地面和天花板均为灰色。无家具或文字。来自右上方的强烈自然光照亮了脸部和身体右侧。长长的阴影投向左下方，长廊深处沉入黑暗。冷灰色、深黑色与温暖肤色之间形成高对比度。

构图与相机：腰部高度的低角度拍摄。全身照，包含双脚。50mm 等效焦距，纵向构图。焦点对准脸部和服装，背景带有柔和的虚化效果。

质感与风格：照片级真实感，令人联想到高端日本时尚杂志。皮肤呈现出通透且自然的质感，可见毛孔。分辨率清晰，且不过度后期处理。
